title: Canonical finite trace-diagonal maps
statement: For a finite commutative coefficient ring, use the native small pro-etale derived tensor, pullback and compact-support functors. Define the coefficient unit, signed symmetry, unit constraints, change of compactification, compact-support section contraction, diagonal pullback, projection isomorphism, diagonal contraction and self-square exchange by the ordered canonical composites of def-pur-td-datum. These are exactly the original generic constructions extracted from FiniteTraceDiagonalDatum; all finite-Tor and etale-origin hypotheses stay identical.

source.place: Canonical-map paragraph and the displayed unit

proof.text: Compose the existing signed tensor, projection, pullback, compactification-change, compact-support composition and identity isomorphisms in the specified order. Invert only the canonical projection and self-square exchange maps under their published finite-Tor certificates. This is an extraction of constructed data, with no postponed data or proof.

proof_origin.place: Naturality of the specified canonical maps
